glossary.definition: (2) "On-premises brand promotion" means a promotion of a brand of beer or intoxicating liquor by a distributor, manufacturer, trade marketing professional, solicitor, or broker of that brand at a retail permit premises.
glossary.source_title: Section 4301.245 - Use of social media for advertising.

glossary.definition: (3) "Product location communication" means a listing or program that allows an individual to determine the availability of a specific brand of beer or intoxicating liquor at retail permit holders or agency stores in a certain geographic area.
glossary.source_title: Section 4301.245 - Use of social media for advertising.

glossary.definition: (4) "Social media" means a service, platform, or web site where users communicate with one another free of charge and share media such as pictures, videos, music, and blogs. "Social media" includes the web site of a distributor, manufacturer, trade marketing professional, solicitor, or broker.
glossary.source_title: Section 4301.245 - Use of social media for advertising.

glossary.definition:
(5) "Trade marketing professional" has the same meaning as in section 4301.171 of the Revised Code.

(B) Notwithstanding section 4301.24 of the Revised Code and except as provided in division (C) of this section, a distributor, manufacturer, trade marketing professional, solicitor, or broker may use free services provided by social media to advertise any of the following:

(1) An on-premises brand promotion;

(2) Beer, wine, or spirituous liquor tasting samples sold in accordance with this chapter or Chapter 4303. of the Revised Code;

(3) A product location communication.

(C) No distributor, manufacturer, trade marketing professional, solicitor, or broker shall use free services provided by social media to advertise to persons under twenty-one years of age.
